mapper.sql: select t.id, t.task_id, t.step_name, t.handler_role, t1.real_name as handler, t.status, t.handle_time, t.handle_result, t.remark, t.create_time from task_flow t left join sys_user t1 on t.handler = t1.username or t.handler = t1.real_name
mapper.delete:
delete from task_flow where task_id = #{taskId}
and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
